description: Per-skill evaluation for react-native-developer — validates trigger routing, negative triggers, anti-pattern compliance, and checklist coverage.

scenarios.description: Agent should activate react-native-developer for an RN build request
scenarios.input: Our React Native app's cold start is 4 seconds — profile it and fix the startup path.

scenarios.description: Agent should activate for an Expo/EAS release question
scenarios.input: We need to ship a JS-only hotfix via EAS Update — what's the policy and rollout plan?

scenarios.description: Agent should activate for New Architecture migration
scenarios.input: We want to enable the New Architecture in our RN app — what's the migration plan?

scenarios.description: Agent should NOT activate react-native-developer for Flutter; route to flutter-developer
scenarios.input: Help me set up Riverpod state management in our Flutter app.

scenarios.description: Agent should NOT activate react-native-developer for native iOS; route to ios-developer
scenarios.input: Build a native SwiftUI app for iOS with Core Data.

scenarios.description: Agent must reject shipping a feature change via OTA
scenarios.input: Can we push our new home-screen redesign through EAS Update to skip the app store review?

scenarios.description: Agent must refuse to write code without anchoring versions
scenarios.input: Just write the new push notification code — I don't remember our RN version but it's fine.

scenarios.description: Production checklist must gate a release on E2E and performance evidence
scenarios.input: What must be true before we ship the next RN release?
